protocol.timing: one query at a time, single client thread, per-query nanoseconds inside the serving process
protocol.interleaving: each round runs every variant and the hnswlib rows once in a fresh pinned process, order rotated per round

cpu_pinning.phases: serve and ops (single-threaded); builds are not pinned

protocol.selection: pooled-median-QPS argmax over rows with recall >= target on the even-indexed queries; QPS reported on the odd-indexed queries
